items.text:
`tp-skeleton` is a decorative placeholder. Its containing layout determines the space it reserves; changing motion never changes that geometry. Import `@tweakpad/ui/register` and `@tweakpad/ui/styles.css`. | Property / attribute | Values | Default | | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------- | | `motion` | pulse, sweep, none | pulse | | `animated` | boolean; false suppresses either animation | true | | `motionPolicy` / `motion-policy` | inherit, normal, reduce | inherit | | `label` | string; not announced | Loading | The shared reduced-motion policy and `tp-motion-request` loading role apply to both motion treatments. Shared duration tokens govern timing. The `skeleton` part is always `aria-hidden`; provide one loading status on the surrounding region when needed. Skeleton does not own or announce the eventual content. ```html
``` Use normal layout to set width and height. Set the host border radius with a shared radius token for circular or other shapes. For example, `border-radius:var(--tp-radius-full)` inherits into the placeholder. Alternatively use `partPresentation.skeleton.styleHook` with shared radius tokens. The `skeleton` part also supports the part contract/delegate API. Skeleton has no spacing attributes, interaction events, form value or focus behavior. Export: `TpSkeleton` and `skeletonMotionRoles`. Docs include avatar, media preview, card, text, form and table loading layouts. All use Skeleton with ordinary theme-relative layout. The media preview composes Aspect Ratio to reserve its two-to-one region; Card supplies the card composition's sections. Form and table placeholders are decorative layout, not empty interactive controls or fake table data.

items.title: Media preview
items.description: Reserve a two-to-one media region and its captions while content loads.

items.title: Form
items.description: Reserve the labels, inputs and submit action while form data loads.

items.title: Table
items.description: Reserve repeated row geometry without exposing fake data or focusable controls.
